instrument: Wikimedia clickstream, referrer class other-search, median monthly, three months; the same capture the per-city signal reads
what_this_measures: that speakers of a language search for a LIST of a kind of thing in a place. It is family intent, not entity demand, and not commercial intent.
what_it_cannot_measure: a transactional or tool intent, the commercial value of a query, or whether any particular place deserves a page
why_a_minimum: a kind represented by two articles has no distribution to read; the mean of two readings is an anecdote with a decimal point

kinds.list_kind: の歴代選手・スタッフ一覧

languages_this_instrument_cannot_reach.es: lists live in the Anexo: namespace, which the clickstream does not cover: 4 articles and 471 clicks in three months
languages_this_instrument_cannot_reach.it: Italian Wikipedia does not title its lists this way: 219 articles in three months against 91,134 for English
